verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents both paths in the story. In the console, the search page is where you find machines and create instances, and templates launch with one click. Programmatically, a REST API, CLI and SDK cover the full lifecycle (search, rent, wait for boot, connect, copy data, clean up), with SSH and Jupyter access to run code; the vendor also claims instances spin up in seconds. Community users say it 'works great', but one notes it takes 'multiple hoops' compared with AWS/GCP. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of time-to-running-code, evidence of consistent boot times across marketplace hosts.
